objective: Redefine mouse controls so drag pans with terrain anchoring, wheel zooms toward the terrain intersection under the pointer, Ctrl+drag rotates around the clicked terrain pivot, and Shift+drag remains terrain-anchored pan.

assumptions.pivot: Nearest ray intersection between pointer and current blended terrain mesh.
assumptions.no_intersection_fallback: Screen-space pan for drag and regular distance scaling for wheel zoom.
assumptions.ctrl_drag: Rotation is applied first, then panX and panY are solved to keep the pivot projected under the pointer.
assumptions.shift_drag: Retained as pan gesture, now using the same terrain-anchored projection rule as plain drag.

outputs.ui_hint: drag: terrain pan | wheel: zoom to terrain | ctrl+drag: pivot rotate | shift+drag: terrain pan

crs.input_crs: Unchanged from loaded viewer experiment, normally EPSG:3857
crs.crs_inference: No new geospatial input was introduced.

rasterization.resolution: Unchanged; uses the already-loaded viewer mesh resolution
rasterization.aggregation_rule: Unchanged; minimum z for Cloud DEM rasterization in the project pipeline
rasterization.validity_mask: Finite cells in the selected blended surface

metrics.formula: Not applicable for this UI interaction change.

verification: Static content checks for new hint, drag mode selection, drag anchor, pivot-preserving Ctrl rotation, and wheel zoom anchor
